title.zh: 第 11 章解題心法 · 面對圓形幾何可以怎樣入手？
title.en: Chapter 11 Study Notes · How to Approach Circle Geometry

lead.zh: 做圓形幾何題目時，切忌一見圖形就憑感覺亂猜。先看清角的頂點和兩邊位置，判斷應該用哪一套定理，再把已知條件一步步連到所求。以下七個思考方向，帶你由淺入深建立清晰的解題思路。
lead.en: In circle geometry, avoid guessing properties just by looking at the shape. Start by checking the vertex and arms of each angle to decide which theorem applies, then connect the given information step by step to what you need to find. Follow these seven steps to build a clear problem-solving strategy.

title.en: To Arc, or Not to Arc?

subtitle.zh: 先認清頂點與兩邊：三步決定用哪套定理
subtitle.en: Check Vertex and Arms: Three Steps to Pick the Right Theorem

body.zh: 第一步，先看角的頂點和兩條邊：頂點在圓心的是「圓心角」；頂點在圓周且兩邊都是弦的是「圓周角」（所對的弧不經過頂點）。只要認出這兩種角並找到對應的弧，就應優先考慮使用圓形定理——最常見的思路是順著這條弧，看看它有沒有連接到圓周上其他點或圓心，從而形成同對這條弧的其他圓周角或圓心角，直接運用「同弓形內的圓周角」（angles in the same segment）或「圓心角兩倍於圓周角」（angle at centre twice angle at circumference）。第二步，留意「圓內接四邊形的對角或外角」雖然不用靠找弧來判斷，但同樣直接屬於圓形定理，確認四點共圓後即可使用。第三步，若兩者皆非（例如其中一邊只畫到圓心），千萬別硬套圓形定理，應先當作普通角，用等腰三角形或平行線等基礎性質推算；有需要時才把線段延長至圓周並標明交點。
body.en: First, inspect the vertex and both arms of the angle: a vertex at the centre gives an angle at the centre, while a vertex on the circle with chords as arms gives an angle at the circumference (intercepting the arc that excludes its vertex). Once you spot either type and identify its intercepted arc, prioritize circle theorems. A key habit is to trace whether that same arc connects to other points on the circle or the centre, forming other circumference or central angles on the same arc—allowing you to apply 'angles in the same segment' or 'angle at centre twice angle at circumference'. Second, remember that opposite angles and exterior angles of a cyclic quadrilateral do not depend on tracing an arc, yet they are direct circle theorems you can use once four concyclic points are confirmed. Third, if an angle fits neither case (such as an arm stopping at the centre), do not force a circle theorem; treat it as an ordinary angle using isosceles triangles or parallel lines first, or extend the segment to the circle and mark the new intersection.

title.zh: 選一個角，沿兩邊找對應的弧
title.en: Select an angle and trace its arms

lead.zh: 圖中只畫到圓心的線段不會自動延長。留意圓心角和圓周角雖然對著同一條弧，但所用的定理並不相同。
lead.en: Segments ending at the centre are not extended automatically. Notice that central and circumference angles can intercept the same arc, yet they follow different theorems.

title.en: One arc, two angle types

caption.zh: 先找不經 C 的弧 AB：圓心角 120°，圓周角 60°。
caption.en: Trace arc AB excluding C: the central angle is 120° and the circumference angle is 60°.

steps.zh: 先找不經 C 的弧 AB：圓心角 120°，圓周角 60°。
steps.en: Trace arc AB excluding C: the central angle is 120° and the circumference angle is 60°.

title.en: An arm stops at the centre

caption.zh: 角 OAB 的 AO 只到圓心：先用 OA = OB，得到兩個相等底角。
caption.en: AO stops at the centre: use OA = OB to obtain equal base angles.

label.en: An arm stops at the centre

steps.zh: 角 OAB 的 AO 只到圓心：先用 OA = OB，得到兩個相等底角。
steps.en: AO stops at the centre: use OA = OB to obtain equal base angles.

title.en: Common Shapes Are Not So Common

subtitle.zh: 六大常見圖形，一眼看出關鍵關係
subtitle.en: Six Common Configurations to Spot Key Relationships

body.zh: 「真蝴蝶」、「假蝴蝶」、「飛鏢」和「招財進寶」是課堂上幫助大家快速認圖的記憶口訣。認出外形後，必須核對哪些點在圓周上、哪一點才是圓心，以及兩角是否對著同一條弧。特別要注意：「飛鏢」與「招財進寶」本質上是同一個定理（圓心角兩倍於圓周角），只是兩側圓周點的位置高低不同；而且「招財進寶」的圓心並不在圓周上，因此它並不是圓內接四邊形，對角之和並不等於 $180^\circ$！另外，遇到「飛鏢」或「招財進寶」時，有一招非常實用的輔助線技巧：連接圓心與圓周頂點的半徑，便可把圖形一分為二，變成兩個等腰三角形。點選下方圖形，觀察相關的弧與角度關係。
body.en: Nicknames like 'the butterfly', 'the fake butterfly', 'dart', and 'fortune fan' are handy visual cues for recognizing classic setups. Once you spot the outline, always verify which points lie on the circle, which point is the centre, and whether the angles intercept the same arc. In particular, 'dart' and 'fortune fan' are governed by the exact same theorem (angle at centre twice angle at circumference)—the only difference is whether the two side vertices sit below or above the centre. Furthermore, because the centre does not lie on the circle, a 'fortune fan' is NOT a cyclic quadrilateral, so its opposite angles do NOT sum to $180^\circ$. A classic problem-solving trick for both 'dart' and 'fortune fan' is to join the centre to the top circumference vertex, splitting the figure into two isosceles triangles. Click the diagrams below to highlight the relevant arcs.

title.zh: 圓即是半徑，半徑即是圓
title.en: Circle Is Radius, Radius Is Circle

subtitle.zh: 善用半徑，製造等腰三角形
subtitle.en: Use Radii to Create Isosceles Triangles

body.zh: 在圓形幾何中，最容易被忽略的隱藏條件就是「同圓半徑相等」。只要從圓心連起兩條半徑，再配上一條弦，就能立刻組成等腰三角形，把圓心角和底角連繫起來；例如在「飛鏢」或「招財進寶」中補畫一條半徑連接圓心與圓周頂點，便能立即拆出兩個等腰三角形。解題時不必一開始就把所有半徑全畫出來，以免線條太亂；只需按推理需要逐條連接，並隨手標上等長記號，隱藏的角度關係便會一目了然。
body.en: One of the most frequently overlooked clues in circle geometry is that all radii of the same circle are equal. Joining any two radii to a chord immediately creates an isosceles triangle, linking the central angle to its base angles—for example, drawing one radius to connect the centre to the circumference vertex in a 'dart' or 'fortune fan' immediately splits it into two isosceles triangles. Avoid drawing every possible radius at the very beginning, as too many lines will clutter the diagram. Instead, add only the radii needed for your next step and mark them as equal.

intro.zh: O 是圓心。先連兩條有用的半徑，觀察它們與弦 AB 組成的三角形。
intro.en: O is the centre. Join two useful radii and examine the triangle they form with chord AB.

steps.zh: 連接 OA 和 OB，與弦 AB 組成三角形：$\triangle OAB$。
steps.en: Join OA and OB to form a triangle with chord AB: $\triangle OAB$.

steps.zh: OA 和 OB 都是同一個圓的半徑，加上相同的等長記號：$OA=OB$。
steps.en: OA and OB are radii of the same circle; mark them as equal: $OA=OB$.

steps.zh: 三角形 OAB 是等腰三角形，因此 A、B 兩個底角相等：$\angle OAB=\angle OBA=p$。
steps.en: Triangle OAB is isosceles, so the base angles at A and B are equal: $\angle OAB=\angle OBA=p$.

steps.zh: 需要用到點 C 時才連接 OC；新增的半徑同樣與原有兩條等長：$OA=OB=OC$。
steps.en: Join OC only when point C is needed; the new radius is also equal to the first two: $OA=OB=OC$.

title.zh: 半徑 → 等腰 → 底角
title.en: Radii → isosceles → base angles

caption.en: OA = OB. A central angle of 120° leaves base angles of (180° − 120°) ÷ 2 = 30°.

label.zh: 半徑 → 等腰 → 底角

steps.en: OA = OB. A central angle of 120° leaves base angles of (180° − 120°) ÷ 2 = 30°.

title.zh: 加一條半徑，拆成兩個等腰三角形
title.en: One radius makes two isosceles triangles

caption.zh: 補畫 OD：OA = OD，OB = OD；兩側的底角各自相等。
caption.en: Add OD: OA = OD and OB = OD. Each pair of base angles is equal.

label.zh: 加一條半徑，拆成兩個等腰三角形
label.en: One radius makes two isosceles triangles

steps.zh: 補畫 OD：OA = OD，OB = OD；兩側的底角各自相等。
steps.en: Add OD: OA = OD and OB = OD. Each pair of base angles is equal.

title.zh: 長度，最後都落在三角形
title.en: All Lengths Lead to Triangles

subtitle.zh: 遇到求長度，連繫三角形與三角學工具
subtitle.en: For Lengths, Connect Circle Properties to Triangles and Trigonometry

body.zh: 圓形幾何的基礎定理主要用來推算角度；一旦題目要求計算線段長度，思路就要轉向「在圓內尋找或構作合適的三角形」，再配合三角學與相似性質求解。面對直角三角形時，除了利用圓心到弦的垂線平分該弦，配合半徑套用畢氏定理 $r^2=d^2+\left(\frac{c}{2}\right)^2$（其中 $r$ 為半徑、$d$ 為弦心距、$c$ 為整條弦長），或利用直徑所對的圓周角為 $90^\circ$ 之外，還別忘了直接運用三角比（$\sin$、$\cos$、$\tan$）求邊長。在 DSE 跨課題題目中，更常出現非直角三角形，這時就要結合圓形定理求出的已知角與半徑，靈活運用正弦公式（sine formula）及餘弦公式（cosine formula）。此外，當兩條弦在圓內或圓外相交時，亦可利用同弓形內的圓周角證明一對相似三角形，再按正確的頂點次序列出對應邊比例。
body.en: Basic circle theorems mainly help you find angles; when a question asks for lengths, shift your focus to spotting or constructing suitable triangles inside the circle, then apply trigonometry or similarity. For right-angled triangles—whether formed by a perpendicular from the centre bisecting a chord (giving Pythagoras' theorem $r^2=d^2+\left(\frac{c}{2}\right)^2$, where $r$ is the radius, $d$ is the perpendicular distance from the centre, and $c$ is the full chord length) or by the $90^\circ$ angle in a semi-circle—remember to use both Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometric ratios ($\sin$, $\cos$, $\tan$). In cross-topic DSE questions, non-right-angled triangles appear even more frequently: combine the angles and radii found from circle theorems with the sine formula and cosine formula to solve for unknown lengths. Finally, when two chords intersect inside or outside a circle, use angles in the same segment to prove similar triangles, and match corresponding vertices carefully before writing side ratios.

intro.zh: A、B、C、D 四點共圓，弦 AC 與 BD 相交於 E。比較三角形 ABE 和 DCE。
intro.en: A, B, C, and D lie on a circle, and chords AC and BD intersect at E. Compare triangles ABE and DCE.

steps.zh: E 在 AC 和 BD 上；角 B 與角 C 同對不經 B、C 的弧 AD：$\angle ABE=\angle DCE=p$。
steps.en: Since E lies on AC and BD, the angles at B and C intercept the same arc AD: $\angle ABE=\angle DCE=p$.

steps.zh: 角 A 與角 D 同對弧 BC，得到第二對相等的角：$\angle BAE=\angle CDE=q$。
steps.en: The angles at A and D intercept arc BC, giving a second pair of equal angles: $\angle BAE=\angle CDE=q$.

steps.zh: 已有兩對相等角，可用 AA 證明相似；對應頂點次序為 A 對 D、B 對 C、E 對 E：$\triangle ABE\sim\triangle DCE$。
steps.en: Two pairs of equal angles establish AA similarity; match A with D, B with C, and E with E: $\triangle ABE\sim\triangle DCE$.

steps.zh: 按剛才對準的頂點次序，寫出對應邊比例：$\frac{AE}{DE}=\frac{BE}{CE}\quad \frac{BE}{CE}=\frac{AB}{DC}$。
steps.en: Follow that exact vertex order to write the ratios of corresponding sides: $\frac{AE}{DE}=\frac{BE}{CE}\quad \frac{BE}{CE}=\frac{AB}{DC}$.

title.en: Match equal angles first

caption.zh: 弧 AD 給出 p，弧 BC 給出 q；兩對相等角建立 AA 相似。
caption.en: Arc AD gives p and arc BC gives q. Two equal angle pairs establish AA similarity.

intro.zh: A、B、C、D 四點共圓，弦 AC 與 BD 相交於 E。比較三角形 ABE 和 DCE。
intro.en: A, B, C, and D lie on a circle, and chords AC and BD intersect at E. Compare triangles ABE and DCE.

steps.zh: E 在 AC 和 BD 上；角 B 與角 C 同對不經 B、C 的弧 AD：$\angle ABE=\angle DCE=p$。
steps.en: Since E lies on AC and BD, the angles at B and C intercept the same arc AD: $\angle ABE=\angle DCE=p$.

steps.zh: 角 A 與角 D 同對弧 BC，得到第二對相等的角：$\angle BAE=\angle CDE=q$。
steps.en: The angles at A and D intercept arc BC, giving a second pair of equal angles: $\angle BAE=\angle CDE=q$.

title.en: Then follow the vertex order

caption.zh: △ABE ∼ △DCE：AE 對 DE，BE 對 CE，AB 對 DC。
caption.en: △ABE ∼ △DCE: AE matches DE, BE matches CE, and AB matches DC.

intro.zh: A、B、C、D 四點共圓，弦 AC 與 BD 相交於 E。比較三角形 ABE 和 DCE。
intro.en: A, B, C, and D lie on a circle, and chords AC and BD intersect at E. Compare triangles ABE and DCE.

steps.zh: 對應次序：A ↔ D，B ↔ C，E ↔ E。
steps.en: Correspondence: A ↔ D, B ↔ C, E ↔ E.
steps.answer: AE / DE = BE / CE = AB / DC

title.en: All That Glitters Is Not Gold

subtitle.zh: DSE 常見伏位：弧長成正比，弦長不成正比
subtitle.en: Common DSE Trap: Arc Lengths Are Proportional, Chord Lengths Are Not

body.zh: 在同圓或等圓中，弧長與它所對的圓心角（或圓周角）成正比，例如弧長比為 $1:3$，對應的圓心角比也是 $1:3$。然而，這是 DSE 選擇題最常見的陷阱：弦長並不與圓心角或弧長成正比！即使弦 $AB$ 的長度是弦 $CD$ 的兩倍，弧 $AB$ 也不會是弧 $CD$ 的兩倍，圓心角更不會是兩倍。遇到題目給出「弦長比」時，千萬不要直接當成角度比例計算。
body.en: In the same or equal circles, arc lengths are proportional to their subtended central angles (and circumference angles)—for example, an arc ratio of $1:3$ means the central angles are also in the ratio $1:3$. However, beware of a classic DSE multiple-choice trap: chord lengths are NOT proportional to central angles or arc lengths. Even if chord $AB$ is twice as long as chord $CD$, arc $AB$ is not twice arc $CD$, nor is its central angle doubled. Never treat a ratio of chord lengths as a ratio of angles.

title.en: Arc ratio = central-angle ratio

caption.en: In one circle, 30° : 90° = 1 : 3, so the corresponding arc lengths are also 1 : 3.

steps.en: In one circle, 30° : 90° = 1 : 3, so the corresponding arc lengths are also 1 : 3.

title.zh: 弦長加倍，角度不會加倍
title.en: Double the chord does not double the angle

caption.zh: 半徑為 1：60° 所對的弦長是 1，180° 所對的直徑長是 2；角度比是 1 : 3。
caption.en: With radius 1, a 60° angle subtends a chord of length 1; a 180° angle subtends a diameter of length 2. The angle ratio is 1 : 3.

label.zh: 弦長加倍，角度不會加倍
label.en: Double the chord does not double the angle

steps.zh: 半徑為 1：60° 所對的弦長是 1，180° 所對的直徑長是 2；角度比是 1 : 3。
steps.en: With radius 1, a 60° angle subtends a chord of length 1; a 180° angle subtends a diameter of length 2. The angle ratio is 1 : 3.

title.en: Back and Forth

subtitle.zh: 拆解複雜求角題：順推、設 $x$ 逆推與雙未知數
subtitle.en: Tackling Complex Angle Problems: Working Forwards, Setting $x$, or Two Unknowns

body.zh: 面對步驟較多的求角題，有三條實戰出路：如果已知角可以直接套用定理，就由已知條件一路順推；如果由已知角推不下去，而所求角附近反而容易連繫其他角，不妨直接設所求角為 $x$，把相關的角逐一用 $x$ 表示，最後利用已知角、三角形內角和或平行線等關係建立方程。遇到結構較複雜的 DSE 題目時，有時只設一個 $x$ 未必足夠，可以大膽設兩個未知數（例如 $x$ 和 $y$），只要寫清每步理由並湊夠兩條獨立方程，一樣可以順利解出答案。
body.en: For multi-step angle problems, use one of three strategies: if a given angle triggers a theorem right away, work forwards from the givens; if you get stuck early on, let the target angle be $x$, express surrounding angles in terms of $x$, and form an equation using a given angle, the angle sum of a triangle, or parallel-line properties. In tougher DSE questions, one unknown may not be enough—feel free to introduce two unknowns (such as $x$ and $y$). As long as every step is justified and you build enough independent equations, the target angle will fall into place.

intro.zh: 已知 AO // BC，弧 AB 與弧 BC 的長度比為 1 : 3，求 ∠BCA。先設所求角為 x，再逐步建立方程。
intro.en: Given AO // BC and arc AB : arc BC = 1 : 3, find ∠BCA. Let the target angle be x, then build an equation step by step.

steps.zh: 先設所求為 x；圓周角 BCA 所對的是不經 C 的弧 AB：$\angle BCA=x$。
steps.en: Let the target angle be x; circumference angle BCA intercepts arc AB excluding C: $\angle BCA=x$.

steps.zh: 利用平行線的內錯角相等，把 x 轉移到頂點 A：$\angle CAO=x$。
steps.en: Use alternate angles on parallel lines to transfer x to vertex A: $\angle CAO=x$.

steps.zh: 連接 OC；兩條半徑相等，等腰三角形 OAC 的底角相等：$OA=OC\quad \angle ACO=\angle CAO=x$。
steps.en: Join OC; equal radii make triangle OAC isosceles, so its base angles are equal: $OA=OC\quad \angle ACO=\angle CAO=x$.

steps.zh: 連接 OB；同對弧 AB 的圓心角是圓周角的兩倍：$\angle AOB=2x$。
steps.en: Join OB; the central angle on arc AB is twice the circumference angle: $\angle AOB=2x$.

steps.zh: 在同一個圓中，弧長比等於相應的圓心角比：$\angle BOC=3(2x)=6x$。
steps.en: In the same circle, the arc-length ratio equals the corresponding central-angle ratio: $\angle BOC=3(2x)=6x$.

steps.zh: 在三角形 OAC 中，頂點 O 的內角由 2x 和 6x 組成；把三個內角相加：$x+x+(2x+6x)=180^\circ$。
steps.en: In triangle OAC, the interior angle at O consists of 2x and 6x; sum all three interior angles: $x+x+(2x+6x)=180^\circ$.

steps.zh: 解方程求得 x，即原本所求的角：$10x=180^\circ\quad x=18^\circ$。
steps.en: Solve the equation for x to obtain the target angle: $10x=180^\circ\quad x=18^\circ$.

title.en: Forwards: from given to target

caption.zh: 已知圓周角 35° → 同弧圓心角 70° → 等腰三角形底角 55°。
caption.en: Given circumference angle 35° → central angle 70° → isosceles base angles 55°.

steps.zh: 已知圓周角 35° → 同弧圓心角 70° → 等腰三角形底角 55°。
steps.en: Given circumference angle 35° → central angle 70° → isosceles base angles 55°.

title.en: Backwards: start with x

caption.zh: 兩條半徑相等，底角都是 x；利用已知圓心角 100°，列式 2x + 100° = 180°。
caption.en: Equal radii give base angles x. With the given central angle 100°, form 2x + 100° = 180°.

steps.zh: 兩條半徑相等，底角都是 x；利用已知圓心角 100°，列式 2x + 100° = 180°。
steps.en: Equal radii give base angles x. With the given central angle 100°, form 2x + 100° = 180°.

title.en: Give Me a Line to Draw, and I Shall Find the Angle

subtitle.zh: 進階技巧：圓心未標示與補畫輔助線
subtitle.en: Advanced Techniques: Unmarked Centres and Auxiliary Lines

body.zh: 當基本定理都用過仍未破題時，便要考慮以下進階操作。第一，若題目沒有標示圓心，可留意「弦的垂直平分線必通過圓心」，或者利用「圓周上的直角（$90^\circ$）所對的弦必為直徑」來找出直徑與圓心位置。第二，若圖中有半徑只畫到圓心，或需要用到圓內接四邊形、半圓直角等性質，可主動補畫輔助線——例如連接兩點構成弦、延長半徑成直徑，或把停止在圓心的線段延長至圓周，但切記在圖上清楚標明新的交點字母，才能準確寫出所對的弧與理由。
body.en: When standard theorems are not enough, turn to two advanced techniques. First, if the centre is not marked on the diagram, remember that the perpendicular bisector of any chord passes through the centre, and a $90^\circ$ angle at the circumference always subtends a diameter—helping you locate both the diameter and the centre. Second, do not hesitate to add auxiliary lines when needed: join two points to form a chord, extend a radius into a diameter, or extend a segment ending at the centre all the way to the circumference. Always label the new intersection point clearly so you can name the intercepted arc accurately.

title.zh: 弦的垂直平分線通過圓心
title.en: A chord’s perpendicular bisector passes through O

caption.zh: M 是弦 AB 的中點，OM ⟂ AB；圓心在這條垂直平分線上。
caption.en: M is the midpoint of chord AB and OM ⟂ AB. The centre lies on this perpendicular bisector.

label.zh: 弦的垂直平分線通過圓心
label.en: A chord’s perpendicular bisector passes through O

steps.zh: M 是弦 AB 的中點，OM ⟂ AB；圓心在這條垂直平分線上。
steps.en: M is the midpoint of chord AB and OM ⟂ AB. The centre lies on this perpendicular bisector.

title.en: Extend a radius to a diameter

caption.zh: 沿 AO 延長至 B，標明新交點。AB 是直徑，所以 ∠APB = 90°。
caption.en: Extend AO to the new intersection B. AB is a diameter, so ∠APB = 90°.

label.en: Extend a radius to a diameter

steps.zh: 沿 AO 延長至 B，標明新交點。AB 是直徑，所以 ∠APB = 90°。
steps.en: Extend AO to the new intersection B. AB is a diameter, so ∠APB = 90°.

intro.zh: AO 只畫到圓心。把它延長到圓周，看看能得到甚麼新條件。
intro.en: AO stops at the centre. Extend it to the circle and look for a new relationship.

steps.zh: 沿 AO 延長至圓周，標明新交點：$A,O,B\text{ are collinear}$。
steps.en: Extend AO to the circle and name the new intersection: $A,O,B\text{ are collinear}$.

steps.zh: AB 經過圓心，兩端都在圓周，所以它是直徑：$AB=2r$。
steps.en: AB passes through the centre with both endpoints on the circle, so it is a diameter: $AB=2r$.

steps.zh: 連接 PB；直徑所對的圓周角是直角：$\angle APB=90^\circ$。
steps.en: Join PB. The circumference angle subtended by a diameter is a right angle: $\angle APB=90^\circ$.

note.zh: 四點共圓時，兩角對著同一條弧，屬於同弓形內的圓周角，所以兩角相等。若兩弦在圓內相交，更可進一步證明一對相似三角形；列比例時務必寫清對應頂點。
note.en: When four points are concyclic and two circumference angles intercept the same arc, they are angles in the same segment and are therefore equal. If the chords intersect inside the circle, they also form a pair of similar triangles—be sure to match corresponding vertices carefully.

steps.zh: 同弓形內的圓周角，兩角相等。
steps.en: Angles in the same segment are equal.

note.zh: 外形極像蝴蝶，但千萬別誤當成兩角相等！先確認 O 是圓心：圓心角 AOB 與圓周角 ACB 同對不經 C 的弧 AB（B 介乎 A、C 之間），所以圓心角是圓周角的兩倍（$\angle AOB = 2\angle ACB$）。
note.en: Despite looking like a butterfly, these two angles are not equal! Confirm that O is the centre first: central angle AOB and circumference angle ACB both intercept arc AB (with B lying between A and C), so the central angle is twice the circumference angle ($\angle AOB = 2\angle ACB$).

steps.zh: 看似蝴蝶，但其中一個頂點在圓心！同對弧 AB，圓心角是圓周角的兩倍。
steps.en: It looks like a butterfly, but one vertex is at the centre! On arc AB, the centre angle is twice the circumference angle.

note.zh: 重點：反角 AOB 是圓周角 ADB 的兩倍（例如 $\angle ADB=102^\circ$ 時，反角 $\angle AOB=2\times102^\circ=204^\circ$，較小的圓心角 $\angle AOB=360^\circ-204^\circ=156^\circ$）。千萬注意：因為 O 是圓心而非圓周上的點，這個圖形並不是圓內接四邊形，所以 $\angle ADB + \angle AOB$ 並不等於 $180^\circ$！解題時有一招常見技巧：連上半徑 OD，即可把圖形拆成兩個等腰三角形（$\triangle OAD$ 與 $\triangle OBD$）。
note.en: Key rule: reflex central angle AOB is twice circumference angle ADB (for example, if $\angle ADB=102^\circ$, then reflex $\angle AOB=2\times102^\circ=204^\circ$, and the smaller central angle $\angle AOB=360^\circ-204^\circ=156^\circ$). Beware: since O is the centre rather than a point on the circle, this is NOT a cyclic quadrilateral, so $\angle ADB + \angle AOB \neq 180^\circ$. A classic trick is to join radius OD, splitting the shape into two isosceles triangles ($\triangle OAD$ and $\triangle OBD$).

steps.zh: 反角 AOB 是圓周角 ADB 的兩倍；注意它不是圓內接四邊形，對角之和不是 180°！
steps.en: Reflex angle AOB is twice angle ADB; note that it is not a cyclic quadrilateral, so opposite angles do not sum to 180°.

note.zh: 本質上它與「招財進寶」是完全相同的定理（圓心角兩倍於圓周角）：只是當 A、B 兩點移到圓心下方時，圓周角 ADB 變成銳角，圓心角 AOB 也小於 $180^\circ$（$\angle AOB = 2\angle ADB$），形成凹四邊形的「飛鏢」外形。同樣地，解題時有一招常見技巧：連上半徑 OD，即可把飛鏢拆成兩個等腰三角形（$\triangle OAD$ 與 $\triangle OBD$）。
note.en: In essence, the dart is the exact same theorem as the fortune fan (angle at centre twice angle at circumference): when A and B sit below the centre, circumference angle ADB is acute and central angle AOB is under $180^\circ$ ($\angle AOB = 2\angle ADB$), forming a concave arrowhead. Just like the fortune fan, a classic trick is to join radius OD to split the dart into two isosceles triangles ($\triangle OAD$ and $\triangle OBD$).

steps.zh: 本質上與招財進寶相同：同對劣弧 AB，圓心角 AOB 是圓周角 ADB 的兩倍。
steps.en: Same theorem as the fortune fan: on minor arc AB, central angle AOB is twice circumference angle ADB.

note.zh: AB 是直徑，P 在圓周上，所以 $\angle APB=90^\circ$。反過來，若已知 A、P、B 三點共圓且 $\angle APB=90^\circ$，便可運用逆定理斷定 AB 是一條直徑。
note.en: Since AB is a diameter and P lies on the circle, $\angle APB=90^\circ$. Conversely, if A, P, and B are known to lie on a circle and $\angle APB=90^\circ$, the converse theorem proves that AB is a diameter.

steps.zh: 直徑所對的圓周角是直角（$90^\circ$）。
steps.en: The angle in a semi-circle is a right angle ($90^\circ$).

label.zh: 直徑 AB 所對的圓周角 APB 是直角
label.en: Angle APB on diameter AB is a right angle

note.zh: A、B、C、D 四點共圓，對角之和為 $180^\circ$。注意圖中兩個對角所對的弧 BD 分別位於弦 BD 的兩側，合起來才是一整個圓，因此不能套用「同弓形內的圓周角相等」。反過來，若一個四邊形的對角互補，可用逆定理證明四點共圓。
note.en: Since A, B, C, and D are concyclic, opposite angles sum to $180^\circ$. Notice that the two opposite angles intercept arcs BD on opposite sides of chord BD, together forming the entire circle—so they are supplementary, not equal. Conversely, supplementary opposite angles prove that four vertices are concyclic.

steps.zh: 圓內接四邊形的對角互補（相加為 $180^\circ$）。
steps.en: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary ($180^\circ$).

title.en: Check the vertex first, then both arms

lead.zh: 點選角名按鈕，逐步檢查頂點及圖上已畫出的線段。這能幫你決定第一步該選哪套定理；若後續補畫延長線，則可發掘更多圓形性質。
lead.en: Select an angle button to inspect its vertex and drawn segments. This guides your initial choice of theorem, while adding extensions later may reveal further circle properties.

q2.zh: 圖上兩邊分別連到哪裏？
q2.en: Where do the two drawn arms lead?

title.en: Special angle: angle at the circumference

body.zh: 這個角所對的是不經 C 的弧 AD。你可以沿著弧 AD 尋找其他連接到圓心或圓周的角：同對弧 AD 的圓心角是它的兩倍；若比較另一個圓周角，則需先確認兩角位於同一弓形內。
body.en: This angle intercepts arc AD excluding C. Trace arc AD to spot other angles subtended by it: the central angle on arc AD is twice its size, while another circumference angle on arc AD is equal to it provided both lie in the same segment.

title.en: Special angle: angle at the centre

body.zh: 兩邊都是半徑（OA 和 OD），所對的是劣弧 AD，大小為同弧圓周角的兩倍。注意：若題目涉及的是優弧，則必須選用相應的反角，不能一律使用較小的圓心角。
body.en: Both arms are radii (OA and OD) intercepting minor arc AD, making this angle twice any circumference angle on the same arc. Note that if the major arc is involved, you must use the reflex central angle rather than the smaller one.

title.zh: 普通角：先用基礎幾何關係推算
title.en: Ordinary angle: use basic geometric properties first

body.zh: 圖中這個角並非由兩條弦或兩條半徑組成，沒有直接對應的弧，不能硬套圓周角或圓心角定理。請先運用等腰三角形、三角形內角和、對頂角或平行線推角；若要延長線段至圓周，必須先標明新交點，再辨認對應的圓周角。
body.en: Since its drawn arms are not two chords or two radii, this angle does not directly intercept an arc—do not force circumference or central angle theorems here. Start with isosceles triangles, triangle angle sums, vertically opposite angles, or parallel lines; if you extend a segment to the circle, mark the new intersection first.

hint.zh: 解題提示：把 CO 經 O 延長至圓周上的新交點 F，射線 CF 與 CO 方向相同，因此 ∠OCA = ∠FCA；角度大小不變，但現在兩邊都是弦，便可清楚指出它所對的弧 FA。
hint.en: Hint: extend CO through O to meet the circle at a new point F. Since rays CF and CO share the same direction, ∠OCA = ∠FCA; the angle stays the same size, but both arms are now chords, clearly intercepting arc FA.

arms.zh: CO 只連到圓心 O，CA 連到圓周上的 A
arms.en: CO stops at centre O; CA reaches point A on the circle

arms.zh: CA 和 CD 兩邊都連到圓周上（A 和 D）
arms.en: Both CA and CD reach the circle (at A and D)

arms.zh: OA 和 OD 兩邊都是半徑
arms.en: Both OA and OD are radii

vertex.zh: 圓內的交點 E（並非圓心）
vertex.en: Intersection E inside the circle (not the centre)

arms.zh: EA 連到圓周上的 A，EO 只連到圓心 O
arms.en: EA reaches point A on the circle; EO stops at centre O

title.zh: 配對練習：哪一隻角對哪一條弧？
title.en: Matching Practice: Which Angle Intercepts Which Arc?

lead.zh: 先點選一個角，再選出它所對且不經過頂點的弧。第 1 回合配對四條不同的弧；第 2 回合比較兩個位於同一弓形內的圓周角。
lead.en: Select an angle, then choose its intercepted arc excluding the vertex. Round 1 matches four different arcs; Round 2 compares two circumference angles in the same segment.

done.zh: 四組全部配對正確！按「下一回合」，看看兩個圓周角如何對著同一條弧。
done.en: All four pairs matched! Select 'Next round' to see how two circumference angles can intercept the same arc.

done.zh: ∠ACB 和 ∠ADB 同對不經 C、D 的弧 AB，屬於同弓形內的圓周角，因此兩角相等。
done.en: Angles ACB and ADB both intercept arc AB excluding C and D; as angles in the same segment, they are equal.
